title: 꽃집에서: 어떤 꽃을 사고 싶어요?
objective: You can tell a clerk what flowers, color and number you want using -고 싶어요, and ask for wrapping.
summary: Learn to buy flowers at a Korean flower shop and say what you want with -고 싶어요.
setting: A small flower shop. A customer is buying flowers for her mother's birthday. Grammar point: verb stem + -고 싶어요 = "I want to (do)". To count flowers, use number + 송이: 한 송이, 두 송이, 세 송이.

task.title: Practice at the flower shop
task.line: Use the dialogue, the word list and -고 싶어요 to answer each question.

words.exampleMeaning: I got flowers on my birthday.
There are lots of tulips in spring.

words.meaning: message card (here, not a bank card)
words.exampleMeaning: Please put a card with the flowers.

dialogue.meaning: Hello. I want to buy some flowers.
How about these roses? They're very pretty.

dialogue.korean: 예뻐요. 그런데 엄마가 노란색을 좋아해요. 노란 꽃을 주고 싶어요.
dialogue.meaning: They're pretty. But my mom likes yellow. I want to give her yellow flowers.
Shall I wrap them for you?

dialogue.korean: 네, 예쁘게 포장해 주세요. 카드도 쓰고 싶어요.
dialogue.meaning: Yes, please wrap them nicely. I'd also like to write a card.

exercises: Change the verb in brackets to the -고 싶어요 form: ① 꽃 사진을 ____. (찍다) ② 꽃집에서 ____. (일하다)
Choose the right counter: 튤립 일곱 (명 / 송이 / 권) 주세요.
Read the dialogue and answer in Korean: 손님은 무슨 색 꽃을 주고 싶어요?
Put the words in the right order: 싶어요 / 꽃을 / 사고 / 빨간
Write in Korean using -고 싶어요: I want to buy a card too.
answers: ① 찍고 싶어요 ② 일하고 싶어요
